globalNotes: Dark theme throughout (near-black background ~#0B0F12 at top fading to pure black ~#000000 lower). This is a WHOOP "Trend View" detail screen for the Heart Rate Zones 4-5 metric. Vertically scrollable; this single screenshot captures the full visible screen from status bar to a partially-cut "ADD ACTIVITY" bottom bar. Status bar at very top shows iOS system: time "09:38" with a muted/silent bell icon, cellular signal bars (2 of 4 filled), wifi icon, battery "38" with charging indication. A floating circular WHOOP logo button (the W mark inside a blue/purple gradient ring) sits bottom-right, overlapping the bottom bar (this is the WHOOP Coach/AI launcher - EXCLUDED). Coordinates in literals are approximate from a 1290x2796 source.

layout.name: Status bar
layout.description: iOS system status bar. Left: time '09:38' in white bold, with a silenced-bell (notifications off) icon immediately right of it. Right cluster: cellular signal bars (2 of 4 lit), wifi glyph, battery pill showing '38' with white fill and a charging look. White icons on dark background.

layout.name: Screen header / nav bar
layout.description: Top app nav. Left: a back chevron '<' (white, thin stroke). Center: title 'TREND VIEW' in white, uppercase, letter-spaced, semibold, ~16px. No right-side action.
layout.interaction: Back chevron returns to the previous (overview/home) screen.

layout.name: Metric selector dropdown
layout.description: Full-width rounded rectangle pill/card, slightly lighter grey than background (~#2A2F33), ~70px tall, rounded ~12px corners. Left: an outlined heart icon (thin white stroke). Center-left: label 'HEART RATE ZONES 4-5' in white, uppercase, bold, letter-spaced, ~20px. Right: a downward chevron 'v' (white) indicating a dropdown to switch which metric/trend is shown.
layout.interaction: Tapping opens a dropdown/picker to select a different trend metric (e.g. HRV, RHR, Strain, etc.).

layout.name: Summary value block (left)
layout.description: Left-aligned summary. Top line: label 'AVG. WEEKLY TOTAL' in muted grey (~#8A9094), uppercase, letter-spaced, ~13px. Below it the big value '0:00' in very large white bold (~64px), with a small superscript-baseline unit 'hr' in muted grey right of it. No trend arrow present (value is zero).

layout.name: Time-range segmented control (W / M / 6M)
layout.description: Right-aligned rounded segmented control, dark pill background (~#1C2024) with three segments: 'W', 'M', '6M'. The middle segment 'M' is selected, shown with a lighter raised grey fill (~#3A4044) and white text; 'W' and '6M' are muted grey text on the dark track. Each ~white/grey uppercase, ~16px.
layout.interaction: Selecting W/M/6M switches the chart aggregation window (Week / Month / 6 Months). Currently 'M' (month) active.

layout.name: Date-range stepper
layout.description: Below the segmented control, right side. A left chevron '<' (muted grey), centered date-range label 'JUN 3 - JUN 30, 26' in white bold uppercase (~18px), and a right chevron '>' (muted grey). The left chevron appears slightly dimmer; right chevron present.
layout.interaction: Chevrons page the date window backward/forward by one month (matching the 'M' selection).

layout.name: Narrative summary text
layout.description: Multi-line descriptive sentence in white, regular weight, ~26px, left-aligned, spanning full width. Full verbatim text: 'You spent 0:00 in zones 4-5 in the last 7 days. This is below your weekly average from the last four weeks (0:00).'
literals: You spent 0:00 in zones 4-5 in the last 7 days. This is below your weekly average from the last four weeks (0:00).

layout.name: Trend chart (zone-time over weeks)
layout.description: A line/bar trend chart area on pure-black background. Y-axis gridlines with labels (top to bottom): '0:30', '0:22', '0:15', '0:07' in muted grey, each with a faint horizontal gridline (~#1A1E22) spanning the width. Below the lowest data gridline sits a dashed horizontal AVERAGE baseline (white dashed line) flagged at the far left by a small white rounded tag reading 'AVG.' in black bold text. X-axis labels below the dashed line, evenly spaced: 'Jun 3 - 9', 'Jun 10 - 16', 'Jun 17 - 23', 'Jun 24 - 30' in muted grey (~#8A9094). No visible plotted bars/points because all values are 0:00 — the series sits flat on the baseline.
layout.interaction: Tapping/scrubbing a data point would surface that week's zone-time value (no points active here since all zero).

layout.name: Data-source footnote
layout.description: Below the chart, an info row: a circled lowercase 'i' info icon (muted grey) followed by grey text 'Zone time is derived from logged activities'. ~24px, regular weight, left-aligned.
literals: Zone time is derived from logged activities

layout.name: HR Zones Breakdown section header
layout.description: Header line: 'HR ZONES BREAKDOWN' in white bold uppercase letter-spaced (~22px), followed inline by '(AVG. WEEKLY TOTAL)' in muted grey, uppercase, smaller (~17px).

layout.name: Stacked zone bar
layout.description: A single full-width horizontal stacked bar (~12px tall, rounded ends) representing the breakdown of zones 4-5. Appears entirely filled with a light orange/amber color (~#F4A84A) — since both sub-values are 0:00 this is the placeholder/empty-state full-width amber bar.

layout.name: Zone 4 legend row
layout.description: Legend row: a small square color swatch in amber/orange (~#F4A84A), then value '0:00' in white bold (~26px), then label 'Zone 4' in white regular. Left-aligned.

layout.name: Zone 5 legend row
layout.description: Legend row: a small square color swatch in a deeper/darker orange (~#E8702A), then value '0:00' in white bold (~26px), then label 'Zone 5' in white regular. Left-aligned, directly below Zone 4.

layout.name: Add Activity bottom bar (partially cut off)
layout.description: Bottom docked bar (only top portion visible, cut off by screen edge), rounded-top, slightly lighter dark grey (~#1E2226). Left: a '+' plus icon (white) with label 'ADD ACTIVITY' in white bold uppercase letter-spaced (~22px). Right: a forward chevron '>' (white).
layout.interaction: Tapping opens the manual activity-logging flow (so zone time can be attributed).

charts.name: Zone 4-5 weekly trend chart
charts.series: Single series of weekly time-in-zones-4-5; flat at zero here so no visible line/markers. Would render in WHOOP's strain/zone palette (amber/orange).
charts.xAxis: Weeks within the selected month, 4 buckets: 'Jun 3 - 9', 'Jun 10 - 16', 'Jun 17 - 23', 'Jun 24 - 30'
charts.notes: Horizontal white DASHED line = AVG. baseline, labeled by a white pill tag 'AVG.' at far left. Faint horizontal gridlines at each y-tick. All data zero so series rests on the average/zero baseline; no on-point annotations or selected markers shown.

charts.name: HR Zones Breakdown stacked bar
charts.series: Horizontal stacked bar splitting avg weekly total between Zone 4 (amber #F4A84A, 0:00) and Zone 5 (deep orange #E8702A, 0:00). Empty state renders as a single full-width amber bar.

excluded: Floating circular WHOOP logo button (W mark in a blue/purple gradient ring) at bottom-right overlapping the Add Activity bar - this is the WHOOP Coach / AI assistant launcher, excluded per community/AI exclusion rule.
